lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\Preferred_Providers\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.
The Composer autoloader is optimized beyond level 1. The manual allows only config.optimize-autoloader: an authoritative class map breaks the upgrade of the app, and APCu is no required extension.
composer.json: config.classmap-authoritative
3 uses of the private API of the server in 2 files. Only OCP and NCU are public: what is below OC changes without notice between majors.

boot() registers a listener or takes a service from the container in 1 place. boot() runs once for every process of the server, so each of them is built on every request. registerEventListener() in register() builds a listener only when its event fires.
lib/AppInfo/Application.php:55 addListener()

Nothing in the app calls 1 route outside OCS. Looked for: a route name or a path in the PHP source and the templates, in 3 files of the frontend source and in the navigation of info.xml. A route stays behind when the frontend stops calling it. A route that only a client outside the app calls shows here as well, unless its method allows requests from other origins (CORS).
GET /index.php/apps/preferred_providers/password/set/{email}/{token}/{ocs}  preferred_providers.password.set_password_ocs  appinfo/routes.php:36 routes

psalm/phar, phpunit/phpunit are in require-dev of composer.json. The manual recommends a vendor-bin/ of bamarni/composer-bin-plugin per tool, so that the dependencies of a tool cannot conflict with those of the app.

2 timed jobs do not say whether they are time sensitive. A job that sets TIME_INSENSITIVE with setTimeSensitivity() is moved to the maintenance window of the server; whether a job is heavy enough for that only its maintainer knows.
lib/BackgroundJob/ExpireUnverifiedAccounts.php OCA\Preferred_Providers\BackgroundJob\ExpireUnverifiedAccounts
lib/BackgroundJob/NotifyUnsetPassword.php OCA\Preferred_Providers\BackgroundJob\NotifyUnsetPassword
lib/ reads the clock directly in 5 places. OCP\AppFramework\Utility\ITimeFactory, a PSR-20 ClockInterface, gives the same time and can be replaced in a test.
